title: Ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier: its saved values are stale, so a correct fix cannot pass
evidence: The verifier recalculates the agent's output in LibreOffice (managed_recalculated_xlsx, force_recalculation=True). It does not recalculate gt_01_golden.xlsx; it compares against the GT's saved values. Those saved values are inconsistent within the GT itself. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!U41 is '=+M17' with a saved value of 0.137, while M17 in the same file has a saved value of 0.092. U43 is '=+M27' with a saved value of 0.264, while M27 is 0.2215. C11 is '=+C20' with a saved value of 18.2034, but it recalculates to 14.2034. I recalculated the GT in LibreOffice and scored it with score_workbooks against the spec's answer_position. Result: regression 0.9934 (threshold 0.998) and modification 0.9756 (100% required), with 65 cell errors. Examples: 'Modification error at Ex 1 - LBO!U17: answer=6467.79, output=6211.81', 'Ex 1 - LBO!U38: answer=1358.86, output=1078.93', 'Ex 2 - Valuation Bridge!C8: answer=20567.08, output=19673.94', plus regression errors at Ex 5 - M&A!K79:U81 (136.53 vs 106.53, etc.). The task has one verifier with weight 1 and pass/fail scoring, so even an agent that makes exactly the three GT fixes gets 0. The verifier cannot pass.
confirmation: The golden's saved values contradict its own formulas (U41=0.137 vs M17=0.092, U43=0.264 vs M27=0.2215, C11=18.2034 vs C20=14.2034). The verifier recalculates only the output, so a correct fix cannot match and the GT replay scored 0.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies run through the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (data tables frozen first). The cached values left corrupted by LibreOffice's TABLE() evaluation (C11, C32, U41, U43 and 61 others) now equal their formulas, e.g. C11=14.2034 and C32=101.3452. The 100 'Ex 1 - LBO' what-if data-table cells (AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49) are cut out of answer_position (verifier parameter and guidance). Under LibreOffice they all hold one copied header string, and an openpyxl-saved file has none. Locally the new golden, the old golden and an openpyxl-saved golden all grade 1.0, and the unfixed input grades 0.

Cached total sources F22=11510.772151908 also disagree with total uses F28=12412.840791578. The verifier forcibly recalculates the submitted workbook but compares it against the unrecalculated golden caches. Passing the golden workbook itself through that recalculation and scoring pipeline produces 54 regression errors and 11 modification errors: regression 0.9934 and modification 0.9756. This fails the sole verifier, which has weight 1, yielding zero credit even for the supplied answer key.

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The GT scored 0.00 on the sole verifier. gt_01_golden.xlsx carries stale caches, e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C32 '=+C30*(1+C31)' cached 109.5182 instead of 101.3452 and C11 '=+C20' cached 18.2034 while C20 = 14.2034, so the recalculated output can never match.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: Verifier fails even on the ground-truth golden workbook due to data-table freezing mismatch between un-recalculated GT/input and recalculated output
evidence: In `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1), the agent's `output_path` is recalculated via `managed_recalculated_xlsx(..., force_recalculation=True)`, which calls `freeze_datatable_formulas(patched_input)` before running LibreOffice so that LibreOffice's destructive `TABLE(...)` Multiple Operations evaluation does not overwrite live model cells. However, `gt_path` (`gt_01_golden.xlsx`) and `reference_path` (`untouched_input_Unit Mismatch_input.xlsx`) are loaded directly without `managed_recalculated_xlsx`, and both files were saved by LibreOffice WITH un-frozen `TABLE(...)` formulas (`Ex 1 - LBO!AG18:AK49`). When `gt_01_golden.xlsx` was saved, LibreOffice's Multiple Operations substituted the final sensitivity table's last row/column headers (`AF22=0.34`, `AK22=16.2034`, `AF31=0.264`, `AK31=0.137`, `AF40=18.2034`, `AK44=17.81209`, `AF49=18.2034`) into live model cells (`C31`, `C20`, `M27`, `M17`, `C11`), stranding 65 cells in `gt_01_golden.xlsx` and `untouched_input_Unit Mismatch_input.xlsx` with corrupted cached values (e.g., `Ex 1 - LBO!C11` has formula `=+C20` where `C20=14.2034`, but cached value `18.2034`; `C32` has formula `=+C30*(1+C31)` = `81.73*1.24 = 101.3452`, but cached value `109.5182 = 81.73*1.34`; `U41` has `=+M17` = `0.092`, but cached value `0.137`; `U43` has `=+M27` = `0.2215`, but cached value `0.264`; and the 100 data-table cells `AG18:AK49` all have `2.4x/19%`). When `managed_recalculated_xlsx` freezes `TABLE(...)` formulas on the agent's output (or on `gt_01_golden.xlsx` itself) and recalculates in LibreOffice, those 65 cells evaluate to their true uncorrupted values (`C11=14.2034`, `C32=101.3452`, `U41=0.092`, `U43=0.2215`, etc.), causing `gt_01_golden.xlsx` itself to FAIL verification with `score=0` (`regression 0.9934, modification 0.9756, 65 cell error(s)`). Across all 3 units (unit 1, unit 2, unit 3), the exact same 5 false regression errors (`Ex 1 - LBO!C11: answer=18.2034, output=14.2033949536391`, `C32: answer=109.5182, output=101.3452`, `C34`, `C37`, `F20`) appear at the top of the failure report. In unit 3, the agent identified and applied all 3 golden fixes (`Ex 1 - LBO!C47=0.04`, `Ex 3 - PF P&L!C13:G13`, `Ex 5 - M&A!J28:N28`), yet it is impossible for any valid formula-preserving workbook to pass.
confirmation: Confirmed in gt_01_golden.xlsx: C11 cache 18.2034 vs C20 14.2034, U41 '=+M17' cache 0.137 vs M17 0.092, U43 '=+M27' cache 0.264 vs M27 0.2215. These are TABLE()-corrupted caches, so the recalculated output differs from the un-recalculated golden and even the golden fails.
fix: Replaced gt_01_golden.xlsx and the untouched reference with copies run through the verifier's own LibreOffice recalculation (data tables frozen first). The cached values left corrupted by LibreOffice's TABLE() evaluation (C11, C32, U41, U43 and 61 others) now equal their formulas, e.g. C11=14.2034 and C32=101.3452. The 100 'Ex 1 - LBO' what-if data-table cells (AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49) are cut out of answer_position (verifier parameter and guidance). Under LibreOffice they all hold one copied header string, and an openpyxl-saved file has none. Locally the new golden, the old golden and an openpyxl-saved golden all grade 1.0, and the unfixed input grades 0.
